aiGuidance.purpose: I-120 exclusion: datatype number. `word_count` already carries this classification, but none of its values (42, 28, 150, 75, 99) is long enough to probe — a content match for "42" proves nothing. Repointing one of them at a distinctive value was the smaller change and was rejected: #317 requires the fixture's existing stored values be preserved, and they are part of what the 18 pre-existing scenarios were written against. This Field exists solely to carry a token that appears nowhere else in the fixture. Its value is load-bearing for i120_exclude_number.
